PLEASE BE NOTED THAT THIS FEATURE WORKS ONLY WITH EVRC-IP VERSION 2.2.0 or higher.
Clears the array of number where each represents a device number for EVRC-IP.

If the list is empty ALL modules in the network will process the command.

schema.description: This model represents set of forward numbers that can be used in forward rule. it must contain from 1 to 8 numbers

items.description:
- This model describes forward number
- Available forward number patterns:
  * `d+` - digits only, for example, `101`
  * `^sip:([0-9A-Za-z+-_]*@)(( ((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4} )|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)((.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+ ))$` - full SIP-number, for example, `sip:100@sip.bas-ip.com` or `sip:name@192.168.1.2`
  * `^sip:( ((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4} )$` - SIP-number without name and host, for example `sip:192.168.1.2`

requestBody.description:
- Create/Update forward rule. Forward incoming call from logic number (`apartment_id`) to SIP numbers at once or sequentially. Forwarding will work if SIP is configured and enabled with `POST /device/sip/settings` and `POST /device/sip/enable`.
- If there is already forward rule with same `forward_number` it will be updated
- Available forward number patterns:
  * `d+` - digits only, for example, `101`
  * `^sip:([0-9A-Za-z+-_]*@)(( ((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4} )|([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*)((.([0-9]*[A-Za-z+-_]+[0-9]*))+ ))$` - full SIP URI, for example, `sip:100@sip.bas-ip.com` or `sip:name@192.168.1.2`
  * `^sip:( ((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4} )$` - SIP URI without name and host, for example `sip:192.168.1.2`

  * `^sip:( ((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?(?::d{1,5})?)(.|$)){4} )$` - SIP URI without name and host, for example `sip:192.168.1.2`

parameters.description:
### Filtering expression: 
[**field name**] [**compare operator**] [*value*] <**logical operator**>...
|||
|-|-|
**field name**|see the list of available fields in `filter.available_fields[].field_name`
**value**|see the list of available values in `filter.available_fields[].options object`, may be missing 
**compare operator**|see the list of available operators in `filter.available_fields[].compare_operators array`

|Compare operators|Description|Example|
|-|-|-|
eq|Equal| name eq 'Sherlock Holmes'
gt|Greater than| building gt 10
lt|Less than| building lt 10
nq|Not equal| name nq 'Sherlock Holmes'
ge|Greater than or equal| floor ge 5
le|Less than or equal| floor le 5
|**Logical operators**|
and|logical AND| floor le 10 and floor gt 3
or|logical OR| floor le 3 or floor gt 10
not|logical NOT|not floor le 3
|**group operations**|
()|group by priority|(name eq 'Sherlock Holmes' or building eq 221) and floor gt 10

(Required) Number of items
(Required) Page number

### sorting expression:
[**field name 1**], [**field name 2**]... <order (asc or desc)>

### Filtering expression: 
[**field name**] [**compare operator**] [*value*] <**logical operator**>...
|||
|-|-|
**field name**|see the list of available fields in `filter.available_fields[].field_name`
**value**|see the list of available values in `filter.available_fields[].options object`, may be missing 
**compare operator**|see the list of available operators in `filter.available_fields[].compare_operators array`

|Compare operators|Description|Example|
|-|-|-|
eq|Equal| name eq 'Sherlock Holmes'
gt|Greater than| building gt 10
lt|Less than| building lt 10
nq|Not equal| name nq 'Sherlock Holmes'
ge|Greater than or equal| floor ge 5
le|Less than or equal| floor le 5
|**Logical operators**|
and|logical AND| floor le 10 and floor gt 3
or|logical OR| floor le 3 or floor gt 10
not|logical NOT|not floor le 3
|**group operations**|
()|group by priority|(name eq 'Sherlock Holmes' or building eq 221) and floor gt 10

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for localizing logs. Value by default is 'en'

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description:
### sorting expression:

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
### Filtering expression: 
[**field name**] [**compare operator**] [*value*] <**logical operator**>...
|||
|-|-|
**field name**|see the list of available fields in `filter.available_fields[].field_name`
**value**|see the list of available values in `filter.available_fields[].options object`, may be missing 
**compare operator**|see the list of available operators in `filter.available_fields[].compare_operators array`

|Compare operators|Description|Example|
|-|-|-|
eq|Equal| name eq 'Sherlock Holmes'
gt|Greater than| building gt 10
lt|Less than| building lt 10
nq|Not equal| name nq 'Sherlock Holmes'
ge|Greater than or equal| floor ge 5
le|Less than or equal| floor le 5
|**Logical operators**|
and|logical AND| floor le 10 and floor gt 3
or|logical OR| floor le 3 or floor gt 10
not|logical NOT|not floor le 3
|**group operations**|
()|group by priority|(name eq 'Sherlock Holmes' or building eq 221) and floor gt 10

get.description:
Get management server settings.

If Link is enabled - server will sync identifiers, access rules, logs etc.

If realtime logging is enabled - panel will send the logs in realtime to the server.

If heartbeat is enabled - panel will send keep alive to the server every 10 seconds.
When MQTT protocol is used heartbeat is enabled by default.

schema.description: The model describes remote management server settings

is_enabled.description: describes feature status, true - on / false - off

protocol.description: connection protocol that is used to connect to management server (http/mqtt)

settings.description: settings applied to connection to management server

oneOf.description: The model describes remote management MQTT protocol server settings

password.description: password for device authentication on management server

is_encrypted.description:
If enabled you can provide custom certificate with `POST /network/management/settings/certificate`
or device will use default one.

oneOf.description: The model describes remote management HTTP protocol server settings

password.description: password for device authentication on management server

is_heartbeat_enabled.description: If enabled device will send keep alive request every 10 seconds

get.description:
The function of viewing additional IP cameras during a call (up to 4 streams).

This feature is available for v4 monitors and any other SIP devices with a keyboard.

During a call, it is possible to switch between streams by pressing keys from 1 to 5 in the monitor menu.

Key "1" corresponds to the stream of the outdoor panel, keys from "2" to "5" - to additionally added streams (transmission is carried out by DTMF RFC2833).

schema.description:
This model descripte a set of rtsp streams - additional IP cameras (up to 4 streams) that can be viewed by monitor user during call.

This feature is available for v4 monitors and any other SIP devices with a keyboard supporting DTMF protocol (RFC2833).

items.description: each list item is an rtsp uri object


  ```json
    "error": "Wrong JSON body: value `param` was of the wrong type"
  ```

parameters.description:
### Filtering expression: 
[**field name**] [**compare operator**] [*value*] <**logical operator**>...
|||
|-|-|
**field name**|see the list of available fields in `filter.available_fields[].field_name`
**value**|see the list of available values in `filter.available_fields[].options object`, may be missing 
**compare operator**|see the list of available operators in `filter.available_fields[].compare_operators array`

|Compare operators|Description|Example|
|-|-|-|
eq|Equal| name eq 'Sherlock Holmes'
gt|Greater than| building gt 10
lt|Less than| building lt 10
nq|Not equal| name nq 'Sherlock Holmes'
ge|Greater than or equal| floor ge 5
le|Less than or equal| floor le 5
|**Logical operators**|
and|logical AND| floor le 10 and floor gt 3
or|logical OR| floor le 3 or floor gt 10
not|logical NOT|not floor le 3
|**group operations**|
()|group by priority|(name eq 'Sherlock Holmes' or building eq 221) and floor gt 10

info.title: Description

description.content: Returns Time Profiles list
(Required) Number of items
(Required) Page number

### sorting expression:
[**field name 1**], [**field name 2**]... <order (asc or desc)>

### Filtering expression: 
[**field name**] [**compare operator**] [*value*] <**logical operator**>...
|||
|-|-|
**field name**|see the list of available fields in `filter.available_fields[].field_name`
**value**|see the list of available values in `filter.available_fields[].options object`, may be missing 
**compare operator**|see the list of available operators in `filter.available_fields[].compare_operators array`

|Compare operators|Description|Example|
|-|-|-|
eq|Equal| name eq 'Sherlock Holmes'
gt|Greater than| building gt 10
lt|Less than| building lt 10
nq|Not equal| name nq 'Sherlock Holmes'
ge|Greater than or equal| floor ge 5
le|Less than or equal| floor le 5
|**Logical operators**|
and|logical AND| floor le 10 and floor gt 3
or|logical OR| floor le 3 or floor gt 10
not|logical NOT|not floor le 3
|**group operations**|
()|group by priority|(name eq 'Sherlock Holmes' or building eq 221) and floor gt 10

post.description:
Creates Apartment Entity. The `uid` value returned in the response can be used as the `apartmentUid` parameter in next requests:
  * `GET /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}` to get detailed apartment information
  * `POST /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}/identifier/{identifierUid}` to attach identifier
  to apartment
  * `POST /apartment/item/{apartmentUid}/forward/{forwardUid}` to attach forward rule
  to apartment

schema.description:
Apartment entity, used for apartment book and association of identifiers (cards, codes etc.) with the owner

link_id parameter doesn't set by default and must be set from the server side

apartment_address.description: Logical address - an entity defines the device/user address in the address hierarchy and is used during a call, issuing identifiers, creating call forwarding rules etc.

apartment_name.description:
Name for the apartment, owner full name or apartment number usually used.
Nonempty string without leading and trailing spaces

count.description: The number living in the apartment

post.description:
Configures Wiegand input/output.

Wiegand type. All data received on Wiegand input will be converted to selected type

Wiegand output mode. 

- If 'duplicate' mode selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by device. Data will be send ou Wiegand output for selected data types.
- if 'wiegand_control' selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by Wiegand output for selected data types (User will see 'processing' 
screen). Other data types will be controlled by device.

When selected `QR` data type to send to Wiegand output, QR must contain value in `UUID` format 
(full or short)

info.description:
BAS-IP Camdroid panels API specification

The following document outlines every API route available for the next models of BAS-IP Linux based individual outdoor panels, multiapartment outdoor panels, and access controllers:
 - Panels with only one direct call button, without display, and with camera:
   - av-01bd
   - av-01d
   - av-01ed
   - av-01md
   - av-01mfd
   - av-02d
   - av-03bd
   - av-03d
   - av-04fd
   - av-04sd
   - av-04sdi
   - av-04fdi
   - av-04fdip
   - av-05fd
   - av-05sd
 - Panels with only one direct call button, without display, and with keyboard:
   - av-01kd
   - av-01kbd
 - Panels with only one direct call button, without display, and without camera:
   - av-02fdr
   - av-02fde
   - av-02ide
   - av-02idr
   - av-02ipd
   - av-04afd
   - av-04afdi
   - av-04asd
 - Panels with a few direct call buttons and without display:
   - ba-04bd
   - ba-04md
   - ba-08bd
   - ba-08md
   - ba-12bd
   - ba-12md
 - Panels with keyboard, 4 inch display, 2 MP camera, and without face recognition features:
   - aa-07bd
   - aa-07bdi
   - aa-07td
 - Controllers and readers:
   - cr-02bd
info.title: Description

description.content:
Configures Wiegand input/output.

Wiegand type. All data received on Wiegand input will be converted to selected type

Wiegand output mode. 

- If 'duplicate' mode selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by device. Data will be send ou Wiegand output for selected data types.
- if 'wiegand_control' selected all data will be sent to Wiegand output. Access will 
be controlled by Wiegand output for selected data types (User will see 'processing' 
screen). Other data types will be controlled by device.

When selected `QR` data type to send to Wiegand output, QR must contain value in `UUID` format 
(full or short)

post.description:
Setup new secure password.
Password Requirements:
Your password must be between 8 and 32 characters long and include all of the following:
  * At least one lowercase letter (a-z)
  * At least one uppercase letter (A-Z)
  * At least one number (0-9)
  * At least one special character from this set: ! ; * ( ) _ - + . , $ & " № % : | @ ^
  * The password can only contain letters, numbers, and the special characters listed above. No spaces or other symbols are allowed.
Examples of valid passwords:
  * MyPassword123!
  * Secure_Pass$42
  * Hello@@@World912
Examples of invalid passwords:
  * 123456
  * password123 (missing uppercase and special character)
  * PASSWORD123! (missing lowercase)
  * MyPassword! (missing number)
  * My Password123! (contains space, which isn't allowed)
